title: Cahn behind Flater's complaint

tellings.quote: cuz it was Khan that contacted Flater.

plain: In Denver in 1953 a complaint by a man named Herman Flader, in a story that reaches J. Edgar Hoover, was really set in motion by a journalist named JP Khan, because it was Khan who contacted Flader. A researcher named Scott Ramsey says this to Michels without naming a source, in an episode about a reported crash that left sixteen alien bodies. If true, the complaint did not come from Flader on his own but was steered by Khan.
